The control panel has a blue 'Avic' button and a red 'Out' button.
The machine appears to be in a warehouse or storage area with concrete floor.
No power cord, paper tray, or toner cartridge is visible in any photo.
The machine shows signs of wear: scuffs and dirt on the white casing, especially on the right side in photo 2.

Photos of the power cord, paper tray, and toner cartridge.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
